The journey

From prompt pipelines to an independent practice.

EFAJ · AI ARCHITECT

I started where most AI builders start right now — deep in the internals of language models, tuning prompts and stitching together the earliest multi-agent frameworks before they had good names.

Two years later, that's grown into a full independent practice — I ship the AI backend and the interactive product around it, for founders who need something live, not just a deck.

REV. 012024
The Inception
Deep-dived into large language model tuning, prompt pipelines, and the earliest multi-agent frameworks.
REV. 022025
Full-Stack Pivot
Bridged the gap between AI backend processing and interactive 3D frontend architecture — WebGL, GSAP, and real interfaces around real agents.
REV. 032026
Going Independent
Began taking on direct client engagements full-time, delivering production-ready autonomous agent infrastructure for founders and teams.
